first_step_test: One rounded flask with a short raised foot and narrow oval mouth fixes the full silhouette while keeping the interior clear for liquid.

source.notes: Fourth generated five-cell felt-tip contact sheet approved. First was rejected for cell frames and early color; second for face-like symmetric bubbles; third for a bottom-row cork crossing crop boundary. Rejected sheets retained privately.

final_elements.name: flask body
final_elements.description: One rounded potion flask body with broad shoulders and a short raised foot beneath its flat base.

final_elements.name: narrow neck
final_elements.description: Two short parallel neck sides with a narrow oval mouth above the body.

final_elements.name: wavy liquid line
final_elements.description: One wavy horizontal liquid surface across the lower middle of the flask.

final_elements.name: cork
final_elements.description: One tapered cork set into the established neck opening.

final_elements.name: three liquid bubbles
final_elements.description: Exactly three bubbles below the wave: small near upper-left, medium near center-right, small near lower-left; no face pattern.

final_elements.name: glass shines and shadow
final_elements.description: Two open oval shines and one short diagonal shine stroke in upper glass, plus three broken ground strokes under base.

frames.visible_job: Draw the rounded flask body, short foot, narrow neck and oval mouth.
frames.instruction: With black felt tip, draw one rounded flask with broad shoulders and a flat lower edge. Add a short raised foot beneath it, then pull two narrow neck sides up and close their top with an oval mouth.

frames.visible_job: Inside the flask, draw one low wavy liquid surface from the left inner wall to the right inner wall; keep the body and neck unchanged.
frames.instruction: Inside the flask, draw one wavy liquid surface across its lower middle from the left inner wall to the right inner wall; keep the body and neck unchanged.

frames.visible_job: At the open neck, draw a short tapered cork that touches both neck sides and rises above the mouth.
frames.instruction: At the oval mouth, draw a short tapered cork that touches both neck sides and rises above the rim. Put two tiny grain marks on its face.

frames.visible_job: Below the liquid line, draw exactly three separate round bubbles. Leave two short shine strokes in the upper empty glass and put a broken shadow below the bottle.
frames.instruction: Below the liquid line, stagger exactly three bubbles: one small near the upper-left, one medium at center-right, and one small near the lower-left. Add two oval shines and one diagonal stroke above the wave, then three short ground marks below the foot.

final_step.visible_job: Fill only the established lower liquid, cork and glass contours with streaky marker color.
final_step.instruction: Let the black outline dry. Fill the liquid vivid teal, shade the existing cork warm orange and add pale lavender marker inside the flask above the wave; preserve the three staggered white bubbles and all three upper shine marks.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop shows only one round-shouldered flask, short raised foot, narrow neck and oval mouth, leaving the interior empty. These connected shapes give the learner the whole scale and stable starting silhouette.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I inspected all five newly cropped JPGs consecutively. The raised foot, mouth and shoulders persist; the wave, cork and three bubbles arrive in separate jobs. Small upper-left, medium center-right and small lower-left bubbles avoid a face. The three glass shines and three ground strokes remain through the final color. No guides are used.

transitions.observed_addition: The round shoulders, short raised foot, neck and oval mouth remain; one wavy liquid line connects the inner walls.
transitions.instruction_match: The second instruction describes that one new wave across the established flask.

transitions.observed_addition: The raised foot, flask silhouette and liquid wave persist; one tapered cork with two grain dashes seats in the oval mouth.
transitions.instruction_match: The third instruction places the cork at the existing mouth, intentionally covering part of its opening.

transitions.observed_addition: The foot, flask, wave and cork persist; a small upper-left bubble, medium center-right bubble and small lower-left bubble appear below the wave. Two oval shines, one diagonal shine and three ground strokes also appear.
transitions.instruction_match: The fourth instruction names each bubble position and all three shine and ground marks visible in the saved crop.

transitions.observed_addition: All three staggered bubbles, both oval shines, diagonal shine, cork, wave, foot and three ground strokes persist. Orange, lavender and streaky teal fills color established regions.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction asks for exactly those color fills and retention of the established white marks; no new contour appears.
